_about: Adapters and cables CUORE knows about. tested_on lists only what CUORE session records show; everything else is untested. No prices, no ratings, no endorsements.

items.name: vLinker FS USB
items.detail: Genuine STN1170 firmware v4.3.2; reports ELM327 v2.3; COM3 at 115200. The same COM port MultiEcuScan Interface 0 uses.

items.name: Blue bypass cable A5 (CAN-IHS)
items.detail: Declared in CUORE with set_cable; connects the adapter to the CAN-IHS bus.

items.name: Grey bypass cable A6 (CAN-CH)
items.detail: Declared in CUORE with set_cable; connects the adapter to the CAN-CH bus.

items.name: OBDLink MX+ (Bluetooth)
items.detail: Untested with CUORE. Uses an STN chip family, which CUORE handles for other STN adapters, but nothing has been recorded on this model.

items.name: Generic ELM327 clone (USB or Bluetooth)
items.detail: Untested with CUORE. Clones usually lack the STN commands and have small buffers.
